description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of experts across 24 categories, labeled 1 through 24 on the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis represents categories and is labeled “Category”, with categories ordered sequentially from 1 to 24. The vertical axis represents “Number of Experts” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at integer values. Each category is represented by a grouped set of three bars, colored blue, yellow, and green, corresponding to groups labeled G0, G1, and G2, respectively, as indicated in the chart legend. For category 1, the blue bar reaches approximately 6, the yellow bar reaches approximately 2, and the green bar reaches approximately 2. In contrast, for category 24, the blue bar reaches approximately 3, the yellow bar reaches approximately 2, and the green bar reaches approximately 1. The tallest bar across all categories is the yellow bar for category 2, reaching a value of 8. The bars are not sorted by any apparent criteria, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
